in_hebrew.name: Galvan
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Shielded by Jupiter
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Galvan הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Roman family name 'Galvanus', meaning 'shielded by Jupiter'. This name carries a sense of protection and strength, invoking the power of the Roman god Jupiter.

in_greek.name: Galvan
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Shielded by Jupiter
in_greek.long_meaning: Galvan είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. Derived from the Roman family name 'Galvanus', meaning 'shielded by Jupiter'. This name carries a sense of protection and strength, invoking the power of the Roman god Jupiter.

in_latin.name: Galvan
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Shielded by Jupiter
in_latin.long_meaning: Galvan est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Roman family name 'Galvanus', meaning 'shielded by Jupiter'. This name carries a sense of protection and strength, invoking the power of the Roman god Jupiter.
